Players Committee card image of [[Clone Trooper]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploys free to same site as your [Clone Army]: general, leader, or Padawan. Once during battle, if firing a blaster, may cancel and redraw your just drawn weapon destiny. While with your clone, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/clonetrooper.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/clonetrooper.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
